local_review.finding_body: The new test project excluded org.apache.el.ExpressionFactoryImpl during Native Image service discovery solely to force a test-only provider, violating FS-test-contract.2.7 because the flag's necessity originated in test configuration rather than the library or its dependencies. The copied test metadata, filter, and new index bucket also retained javax.el entries for the Jakarta-only artifact; those typeReached conditions could never be reached, violating the condition-integrity rule in FS-contribution-contract.4.9.
local_review.finding_title: Test-only service provider forced by an unjustified Native Image flag
local_review.fix_note: Removed the provider-exclusion build flag and test-only service registration, rewrote the provider tests to exercise Tomcat's bundled ExpressionFactoryImpl through null and delegating context class loaders, removed stale javax.el metadata/filter/index entries, and regenerated normalized metadata and statistics through Forge finalization.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the scoped contribution and local gate evidence. The Jakarta namespace compile repair preserves meaningful EL behavior, stays within the target coordinate, and contains no legacy metadata, native-only skips, or version-pinned tests. Repaired dynamic-access statistics pass the ordered fixes gate: overall 41/41 to 40/45 (11.11 percentage-point drop), reflection 41/41 to 38/41 (7.32-point drop), and resources 0/0 to 2/4. The exact Forge finalization command then completed without changing the publishable tree, covering all three test lanes plus metadata, style, generated-test validity, and statistics checks.
